live.text: This is Hudson, running live in the page. What you are about to see is the real app, moving on its own.

windows.text: Apps open as windows on one shared canvas. Open another, and the canvas re-tiles so every app stays readable.

slots.text: Apps don’t draw their own chrome. They fill slots the shell provides: navigation on the left, an inspector on the right.

palette.text: Every action an app declares becomes a command, so the whole workspace is searchable from one place.

agents.text: Agents call those same commands. This walkthrough runs on them too: each move you see is a Hudson action.

console.text: Underneath it all sits a console, with Hudson AI and a terminal a keystroke away.

everywhere.text: The same primitives ship on iOS, macOS, and the web, so your apps feel at home on each.

close.text: That’s Hudson. Your apps bring the work; Hudson gives them a shared workspace.
